+    n = len(pts)
+    best_d2 = math.pi
+    bi = bj = -1
+    for i in range(n):
+        a = pts[i]
+        for j in range(i + 1, n):
+            b = pts[j]
+            dx = a[0] - b[0]
+            dy = a[1] - b[1]
+            dz = a[2] - b[2]
+            d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
+            if d2 < best_d2:
+                best_d2 = d2
+                bi = i
+                bj = j
+    if bi < 0:
+        return
+    dx = pts[bi][0] - pts[bj][0]
+    dy = pts[bi][1] - pts[bj][1]
+    dz = pts[bi][2] - pts[bj][2]
+    ln = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
+    if ln == 0.0:

+    uy = dy / ln
+    uz = dz / ln

+        nz = pts[k][2] + base * sgn * uz
+        l = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
+        if l == 0.0:
+            continue
+        pts[k] = (nx / l, ny / l, nz / l)
